title: Sephora Gift Card Giveaway...FINALLY!
description: Congrats winners, and stay tuned for more giveaways! :)

asr.full_text: Hello again everyone. Welcome back if you've been here before. If not, my name is Crystal. Nice to meet you. Today, I'm going to be doing the Sephora giveaway that I have been- ... slacking on for so long and I'm so sorry, I just, honestly, I have an awful memory and every time I see someone asking about it I'm like OH MY GOD YES I HAVE TO DO THAT and then by the time I get home that night I forget and I'm sorry so I'm finally doing it. It's finally happening I did go through all my subscriptions the comments everything that shares all that and I've decided to pick two winners those two winners are I Don't know if I'm pronouncing this right because it's just four letters but Anes, A.I.N.S so congratulations Anes You are a a $50 winner of a supporter gift card make sure you message me on my YouTube channel so I can verify that it's actually your channel if you have a problem messaging me let me know and I will try and figure out how to get to you and the other winners that I have is Kaelin Damian so Kaelin Damian and Aynes you both have won a $50 gift card to Sephora. Again, make sure you shoot me and, uh, shoot me a message on YouTube and then that way I can make sure it's you guys. I can verify your channels, your subscriptions, and then I can send you guys your, um, your e-gift certificates or whatever they're called. They're $50 e-gift certificates to Sephora. So, congratulations YouTube, and I also want to say thank you so much to everybody who subscribe to my channel I really really really appreciate it it's just fun I truly cannot put it into words how much I appreciate everybody who watches my videos and comments and likes and shares it just absolutely means the world to me so again thank you so so much I do have other giveaways planned I've got in my head and I'm getting ready to write them down so there will be more giveaways in the future I personally love when pages do like giveaways and stuff So I absolutely wanted to be one of those that does them also just to show you guys how much I appreciate you guys Watching and liking subscribing all that stuff like I seriously truly appreciate it. I can't say enough about it. So congratulations once again to the winners and until next time... BYE!

textual.observation: A $50 Sephora e-gift certificate is offered to selected winners who are asked to contact the creator on YouTube so the creator can verify their channel and subscriptions before sending the certificate.

evidence.quote: make sure you message me on my YouTube channel so I can verify that it's actually your channel
I can verify your channels, your subscriptions, and then I can send you guys your, um, your e-gift certificates

textual.context: Presented as a creator-run giveaway with two announced winners and an expression of appreciation for viewers; the source does not establish whether the offer was fulfilled or whether the requested verification involved any additional information.
textual.potential_relevance: The promised gift card is directly linked to contacting the creator and completing channel and subscription verification, a relationship requiring later context assessment.
textual.limitations: These records do not establish deception, impersonation, unauthorized data collection, payment, loss, or the outcome of the giveaway.

textual_context_notes.observation: The speaker describes the activity as a giveaway intended to show appreciation for viewers and says more giveaways are planned.

evidence.quote: I personally love when pages do like giveaways and stuff So I absolutely wanted to be one of those that does them also just to show you guys how much I appreciate you guys

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it announces two winners of $50 Sephora e-gift certificates in a creator-run giveaway for viewers. Asking winners to message the creator so their channels and subscriptions can be verified is presented as part of the giveaway process, with no payment demand, additional private-data request, deception, or loss described.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The primary subject is an ordinary creator-run giveaway offering Sephora gift cards to selected winners, with a stated contact and channel-verification process. The supplied evidence does not show payment, a purported code generator, sensitive credential collection, or loss.
